description: C8 conformance suite. Every id must be produced by harness.evaluation.conformance.cases; a missing or undeclared case fails the gate.

cases.invariant: a 429 is retried within the policy and can succeed
a 500 is retried within the policy and can succeed
a connection failure is retried
a non-retryable 400 is attempted once
cancellation is never retried
an expired run deadline refuses a retry
a duplicate effect begin is idempotent and finish records done
a crash before begin leaves no row; resume executes exactly once
a crash after begin refuses a retry (unknown outcome, zero effects)
a crash after the effect refuses a retry (exactly one effect)
a crash after finish resumes without re-executing
the exported trace is run -> step -> tool/LLM with one terminal state
the hook vocabulary is closed and includes the step hooks
the portable tool manifest is versioned, digested and honest
the release report carries runs/latency/cost/slos
the plugin SDK declares a version
attempts, fallback numerator and TTFT reach the report
first token becomes a TTFT observation, not a generic event
pressure, summary and skeleton outcomes are distinguishable
batch size, concurrency and guardrail outcome are recorded
an unknown effect is counted and fails the invariant gate
a lost lease reaches the integrity section
created, failed and restored are distinguishable
verdicts roll up into completion and blocked rates
behavioural evaluation outcomes reach the learning section
the release report carries schema v2, capabilities and unmeasured objectives
missing samples fail only when the check requires them
every alert metric exists in the shipped exposition
